Package edu.cnu.mdi.graphics.toolbar

Class BaseToolBar

java.lang.Object
java.awt.Component
java.awt.Container
javax.swing.JComponent
javax.swing.JToolBar
edu.cnu.mdi.graphics.toolbar.AToolBar
edu.cnu.mdi.graphics.toolbar.BaseToolBar
All Implemented Interfaces:
ImageObserver, MenuContainer, Serializable, Accessible, SwingConstants
public class BaseToolBar extends AToolBar
Default MDI toolbar implementation for a canvas.

This class supports a mix of:

  • Mutually exclusive toggle tools (pointer, pan, magnify, box zoom, drawing tools, connector, etc.)
  • One-shot actions (zoom in/out, undo/reset zoom, delete, style, camera, printer)
  • Status field (optional)

GestureContext-first

All interactions are dispatched to IToolHandler using GestureContext. Tools that originate from mouse gestures (press/drag/release, hover move, rubberband) create/update a GestureContext. One-shot actions synthesize a context at the canvas center with a null MouseEvent.

Listener swapping

Only the active toggle tool receives mouse events from the canvas. This toolbar swaps canvas listeners when the active toggle changes, tracking the currently installed listeners directly for O(1) removal.

Extensibility

Applications can add their own buttons after construction using the id-aware methods from AToolBar: 


 toolbar.addToggle("myTool", new JToggleButton("..."));
 toolbar.addButton("myAction", new JButton("..."));
 toolbar.setButtonEnabled("myAction", false);

      public BaseToolBar(Component canvas, IToolHandler handler, long bits, int orientation, ARubberband.Policy pointerPolicy, ARubberband.Policy boxZoomPolicy)

    • setToolsEnabled

      public void setToolsEnabled(boolean enabled, String... ids)
      Enable or disable tools/buttons by id.

      Works for both predefined tools (via ToolBits.getId(long)) and application-added tools (via AToolBar.addToggle(String, JToggleButton) and AToolBar.addButton(String, JButton)).

      Parameters:
      enabled - new enabled state
      ids - tool ids to update (null/blank entries are ignored)
